instruction: Écoute la question en anglais, puis choisis la bonne réponse.

items.hint: La réponse reprend le temps de la question : did → did, have → have, can → can.
items.explanation: last night = hier soir : on répond au passé (I was).

items.hint: La réponse reprend le temps de la question : did → did, have → have, can → can.
items.explanation: What are you doing? = Que fais-tu en ce moment ? : be + -ing.

items.word: Have you ever been to London?
items.hint: La réponse reprend le temps de la question : did → did, have → have, can → can.
items.explanation: Have you…? : on reprend have (Yes, I have).

items.hint: La réponse reprend le temps de la question : did → did, have → have, can → can.
items.explanation: Did you…? : on reprend did (Yes, I did).

items.hint: La réponse reprend le temps de la question : did → did, have → have, can → can.
items.explanation: tomorrow + will : on répond au futur (I’ll = I will).

items.hint: La réponse reprend le temps de la question : did → did, have → have, can → can.
items.explanation: Can you…? : on reprend can (Yes, I can).

items.word: How long have you lived here?
items.hint: La réponse reprend le temps de la question : did → did, have → have, can → can.
items.explanation: How long = depuis combien de temps : for three years (depuis trois ans).

items.hint: Would you like… ? est une offre : comment accepter poliment ?
items.explanation: Would you like…? = Veux-tu… ? : Yes, please (oui, s’il te plaît).
